scope.boundary_rule: Occurrence, publication, collection and evidence-horizon times remain distinct. Later reporting updates earlier events rather than creating duplicate occurrences.

new_events.actor: United States / VTB Bank / Russia / Iran
new_events.summary: The U.S. Treasury imposed Iran-related sanctions on Russia's VTB Bank under an Iran-focused authority, alleging that VTB opened offices in Iran, established correspondent relationships with sanctioned Iranian lenders, built rial-ruble settlement channels, and sought to move billions of dollars in frozen Iranian assets. Treasury warned that foreign institutions continuing certain dealings with VTB could face additional sanctions exposure.

new_events.actor: U.S. Department of Defense Inspector General / State Department / USAID
new_events.summary: A U.S. government watchdog report publicly acknowledged strategic inventory shortfalls and industrial-base bottlenecks for advanced munitions, and provided the fullest official accounting yet of earlier-war damage. AP reported the document said Iranian strikes damaged or destroyed hundreds of structures at U.S. bases across Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Oman and Jordan; up to 30 MQ-9s were destroyed, seven KC-135s were damaged or destroyed, and eleven service members were listed killed in action during the covered period. The report also recorded $184 million in physical damage to U.S. diplomatic facilities and 14-18 day alternate logistics cycles after disruption at Bahrain.

existing_event_updates.summary: Houthis said they fired dozens of missiles and drones at King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, claiming hangars, radar, runways and ammunition depots as targets. Saudi coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Malki said attacks struck civilian areas in Khamis Mushait and nearby cities, injuring 13 civilians and damaging houses and vehicles; he did not confirm the airbase was hit. Preserve Houthi military BDA as an actor claim rather than established damage.

Saudi Civil Defence issued and then lifted danger alerts affecting Yanbu, Jeddah, Abha, Jazan, AlUla and Taif. Yanbu is Saudi Arabia's principal Red Sea oil-loading port. The alerts establish threat activity but not successful impacts in each city.

Kpler preliminary data reported only four commodity-vessel transits through Hormuz on Monday, down from ten Sunday: two dry-bulk carriers exited and two ballast oil tankers entered. AIS-dark traffic may be omitted.
Kpler preliminary data reported 21 commodity-vessel transits through Bab el-Mandeb on Monday, down from 28 Sunday. Traffic remained present despite Houthi territorial gains.

AP reported WHO said more than 500 people were killed in Yemen during the preceding week, up from nearly 200 the week before, and that fighting had displaced nearly 94,000 people. This supersedes the earlier 82,164 displacement figure as a later rounded estimate while preserving the earlier exact IOM count and its publication time.

AP's two regional officials retained the three-to-five-week repair estimate for major East-West Pipeline damage, including a major pumping facility. One official said partial operation during repairs may be possible, but no throughput estimate or restart date was available. Rystad said the pipeline had averaged roughly 2.6-4.0 million bpd since late August.

The previously unidentified large bank in Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's announced Monday sanctions action was identified as Russia's VTB Bank when Treasury imposed Iran-related sanctions on September 14.

claims_and_corrections.claim: Dozens of missiles and drones targeted aircraft hangars, radar systems, runways and ammunition depots at King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait.
Panama-flagged tanker El Gaia was damaged by sea mines while passing through an Iranian-prohibited zone south of Hormuz.
claims_and_corrections.adjudication: CONTESTED; CENTCOM SAID CLAIM_FALSE_AND_ASSERTED_IRANIAN_MISSILE_STRIKE_LAST_MONTH; IMO_REPORTED_DAMAGE_WITHOUT_CAUSE; TWO_SEAFARERS_MISSING; OWNERS_NOT_REACHED_BY_REUTERS

claims_and_corrections.claimant: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council
claims_and_corrections.claim: No talks until Iran's conditions are met.
Saudi Arabia requested postponement of the Oman Gulf-Iran Hormuz meeting.

economic_energy_updates.observed_state: Reuters reported crude prices rose more than 4% intraday Monday before settling roughly 1% higher, while AP reported Brent reached $109 during the session as markets priced Saudi pipeline outage risk.

economic_energy_updates.metric: U.S. war costs and diplomatic-facility damage through June
economic_energy_updates.observed_state: The watchdog accounting cited a previously stated $37.5 billion war cost through late July and newly public $184 million physical damage estimate for U.S. diplomatic facilities in Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and UAE; State Department contingency/evacuation-related costs were also detailed.
